# `daemon/daemon.ts` API Reference

## Overview

The `daemon/daemon.ts` module provides a background processing daemon responsible for orchestrating task scheduling, producer execution, retrospective processing, and score decay. The `Daemon` class drives a polling loop that dispatches queued tasks up to configurable concurrency limits and periodically triggers producer and maintenance routines.

---

## Interfaces

### `DaemonOptions`

Configuration options for the `Daemon` class.

```ts
interface DaemonOptions {
  pollIntervalMs?: number;
  maxConcurrent?: number;
  maxPerUser?: number;
  producerIntervalMs?: number;
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pollIntervalMs` | `number` _(optional)_ | Interval in milliseconds between each dispatch poll tick. |
| `maxConcurrent` | `number` _(optional)_ | Maximum number of tasks that may run concurrently across all users. |
| `maxPerUser` | `number` _(optional)_ | Maximum number of concurrent tasks allowed per individual user. |
| `producerIntervalMs` | `number` _(optional)_ | Interval in milliseconds between producer execution runs. |

---

## Classes

### `Daemon`

```ts
import { Daemon } from 'daemon/daemon';
```

The `Daemon` class manages the full lifecycle of background task processing. It runs a polling loop to dispatch queued tasks, periodically invokes registered producers to enqueue new tasks, and performs maintenance operations such as retrospective processing and score decay.

#### Constructor

```ts
new Daemon(options?: DaemonOptions)
```

Accepts an optional [`DaemonOptions`](#daemonoptions) object to configure polling intervals, concurrency limits, and producer scheduling.

---

#### Methods

> **Note:** All methods below are instance methods of `Daemon`. The prefixed `_` methods are internal and intended for use within the class.

---

##### `start`

```ts
async start(): Promise<void>
```

Starts the daemon, initiating the polling loop and producer scheduling. Resolves once the daemon has been successfully started.

---

##### `stop`

```ts
async stop(): Promise<void>
```

Gracefully stops the daemon, halting the polling loop and any scheduled producer runs. Resolves once the daemon has fully shut down.

---

##### `_tick`

```ts
async _tick(): Promise<void>
```

Executes a single iteration of the main dispatch poll loop. Identifies queued tasks eligible for dispatch, respecting the `maxConcurrent` and `maxPerUser` limits, and calls [`_dispatch`](#_dispatch) for each selected task.

> **Internal** — called automatically by the polling loop started via [`start`](#start).

---

##### `_runProducer`

```ts
async _runProducer(producer: Producer): Promise<void>
```

Runs the specified producer, iterating over all repositories and users the producer is configured for and invoking [`_runProducerForRepo`](#_runproducerforrepo) accordingly.

> **Internal** — called on the `producerIntervalMs` schedule.

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `producer` | `Producer` | The producer instance to execute. |

---

##### `_runProducerForRepo`

```ts
async _runProducerForRepo(
  producer: Producer,
  repo: { id: number; fullName: string; defaultBranch: string | null; provider: string },
  createdBy: number,
  config?: Record<string, unknown>
): Promise<void>
```

Executes the given producer against a single repository, enqueueing any tasks the producer determines are necessary for that repository.

> **Internal** — called by [`_runProducer`](#_runproducer).

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `producer` | `Producer` | The producer instance to run for the repository. |
| `repo` | `{ id: number; fullName: string; defaultBranch: string \| null; provider: string }` | The target repository and its metadata. |
| `createdBy` | `number` | The ID of the user on whose behalf the producer is running. |
| `config` | `Record<string, unknown>` _(optional)_ | Optional producer-specific configuration overrides. |

---

##### `_retrospectiveTick`

```ts
async _retrospectiveTick(): Promise<void>
```

Performs a single retrospective processing pass, re-evaluating completed tasks or historical data as required by the system's retrospective logic.

> **Internal** — called on a scheduled basis by the daemon loop.

---

##### `_decayTick`

```ts
async _decayTick(): Promise<void>
```

Performs a single score decay pass, reducing or expiring time-sensitive scores or metrics according to the configured decay policy.

> **Internal** — called on a scheduled basis by the daemon loop.

---

##### `_dispatch`

```ts
async _dispatch(task: { id: string; status: string; createdBy: number }): Promise<void>
```

Dispatches a single queued task for execution, updating its status and routing it to the appropriate handler.

> **Internal** — called by [`_tick`](#_tick).

**Parameters:**

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `task` | `{ id: string; status: string; createdBy: number }` | The task to dispatch, identified by its ID, current status, and the ID of the user who created it. |
